arguments.message: I'm sorry to hear about your cat. I can help you with changing your flight. To get started, could you please provide me with your user ID and, if you have it, your reservation ID?

resultat: Thank you. My user ID is daiki_lee_6144. I don't have my reservation ID, unfortunately.

arguments.message:

resultat: I need to change the flight from JFK on May 17th.

arguments.message:
I'm sorry, but the reservation departing from JFK on May 17th (**DF89BM**) is booked in **Basic Economy**, and per our policy, Basic Economy flights cannot be modified.

Unfortunately, I'm unable to change that reservation. Is there anything else I can help you with?

resultat: I understand that Basic Economy flights can't be modified. However, this is an urgent situation. My cat is very sick, and I need to get home as soon as possible. I'm willing to pay a fee to change it, but it needs to be less than $100. I also don't want to buy a new flight. Is there really no way to change it to a nonstop flight?

arguments.message:
I completely understand this is a stressful and urgent situation, and I'm sorry you're going through it. Unfortunately, I have to be straightforward with you: our policy does not allow any modifications to Basic Economy reservations—including changing flights or routing—regardless of the reason or willingness to pay a fee. There is no exception I'm able to make, and I can't convert it to a nonstop flight.

The only alternatives would be to keep the existing reservation as-is, or to book a separate new reservation—but I understand you'd prefer not to do the latter.

Is there anything else I can help you with today?
